o.text: A derivation from Proto-Turkic *ār- (“to be tired, exhausted; to become lean”). Cognate with Chuvash ыр (yr, “to become tired”).
Morphologically qapı (“door”) + -çı. Cognate with Crimean Tatar qapıcı.
From zor + -la. For the sense rape, perhaps a calque of Russian насиловать (nasilovatʹ).
